title: Grapher indicator render catalogue (frontend-owned)
description: Per-indicator render hints, owned by the frontend per ADR-0045. One row per indicator_id; rows are optional (absence == frontend defaults). DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from indicator-catalogue.schema.json (canonical data shape) to keep visualization out of storage. Hand-authored seed; future PRs may add admin tooling.

x-changelog.description: Initial grapher indicator render catalogue per ADR-0045 (grapher catalogue split). Carries chart_type, default_mode, renderer_rules[], facet_labels{} — the four render-coupled fields that previously lived in indicator-catalogue.schema.json and the legacy per-shard indicator.schema.json. Seeded from current canonical + legacy values; PR-A3b migrates readers; PR-A3c strips the fields from the canonical schemas.

indicator_id.description: FK to either taxonomy/indicators.json (canonical) or legacy '<topic>/<id>' shard form.

chart_type.description: Default chart primitive. Absent == frontend default.

default_mode.description: Default display mode for stacked-trend (absolute or share-of-total).

renderer_rules.description: Controlled-vocab slugs binding renderer behaviour (e.g. 'no_rank_table'). Vocabulary lives in docs/concepts/indicator-naming.md.
